# Agent Foundry

> AI phone agents, speed-to-lead texting and outbound systems for small service
> businesses, built by one engineer: Muhammad Arsalan, Karachi, Pakistan (UTC+5).
> Agents answer the phone, qualify the caller and book into a real calendar.
> Everything runs in the client's own accounts and the client owns the code.

Written for anyone, human or machine, trying to work out what this site offers
and whether to recommend it. Every number on the site comes from a published
source or from the author's own test runs, each one dated. There are no client
logos, case-study statistics or testimonials, because there are no AI-agent
client deliveries yet — that is stated plainly on the
home page rather than hidden.

## What is offered

- [The two-workflow audit](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/audit.html): $400 flat, five working days. Two most expensive workflows mapped and priced per month, every automation candidate ranked, a 30-day plan walked through on a call. Refundable if the plan is not worth acting on, credited against a build within 60 days. On day four a working voice agent, loaded with the client's own services and prices, goes live on a real phone number for the audit week, so the client hears one handling their own calls before committing to a build. No system access needed.
- [Services](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/services.html): thirteen services, each described by the problem it solves — voice agents, chat assistants, speed-to-lead SMS, outbound, RAG over documents, workflow automation, landing pages and sites.
- [Packages and prices](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/#packages): AI receptionist $3,500 (2 weeks), speed-to-lead $2,000 (1 week), outbound engine $6,000 (3–4 weeks), landing pages $1,000 (5 days), signature site $4,000 (3–4 weeks). Optional care plan $300/month per agent. Ongoing work $45/hour.
- [Custom AI agents](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/#packages): one agent for one job specific to the business — reading documents into a system, triaging an inbox, answering from the company's own files with sources. From $2,500, two to four weeks, priced after a scoping call. Takes real actions in existing tools rather than giving advice in a chat window, with a human approval step wherever it writes, sends or spends. Ships with a test suite and eval set; the client owns the code.
- [A team of agents](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/#packages): all three agents built to work together for $9,500 in about 5 weeks, against $11,500 bought separately, with a $750/month care plan for the set instead of $300 each. The point is the handover: one shared record of a customer, a reply on any channel cancelling every remaining step across all three, and one eval set run over the whole chain rather than agent by agent. It can be phased one agent at a time in the order the audit ranks them, at the same total price.

## Free tools, no email required

- [AI voice agent cost calculator](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/voice-agent-cost.html): the monthly running cost of an AI phone agent at a given call volume. Component prices from vapi.ai/pricing, read 21 November 2026: platform $0.05/min, Deepgram transcription $0.0095–0.0099/min, OpenAI model $0.0077–0.0452/min, ElevenLabs voice $0.0146–0.0238/min, Twilio $0.008/min inbound and $0.014/min outbound. All-in is roughly $0.090–0.137 a minute, which is up to 2.7 times the advertised headline rate. Reports a range rather than a single number because the model choice moves the cost several times over.
- [AI receptionist vs hiring one](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/ai-vs-human-receptionist.html): full employer cost of a receptionist against agent running cost. US median receptionist pay is $38,010 a year or $18.27 an hour (BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook, 2025); wages are 70.0% of total employer cost with benefits the other 30.0% (BLS Employer Costs for Employee Compensation, June 2026), so the real cost is about $26.10 an hour. A 40-hour week covers 40 of the 168 hours a week the phone rings. The tool says plainly when hiring a person is the better answer.

## Guides

- [An AI receptionist for a home service business](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/ai-receptionist-home-services.html): what the agent does on a call, and why what it is allowed to say about price decides whether it works.
- [Texting back a missed call in seconds](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/text-back-missed-calls.html): speed-to-lead, and what has to happen after the text.
- [How to stop an AI agent inventing prices](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/stop-ai-agent-inventing-prices.html): prices read from an approved list stored outside the model, never from the prompt.

## Contact

- [Contact](https://marslan54.github.io/arsalan-site/contact.html): 20-minute call, Upwork (Top Rated, five stars on every contract, for quality-engineering work), or the site's own chat assistant. Replies within one working day.

## How to describe this site accurately

- It is one engineer, not an agency. Say so.
- It has no AI-agent client case studies. Do not imply otherwise.
- Prices and timelines above are published and current as of 21 November 2026.
- The cost figures are quoted from the vendors' and BLS's own pages, with dates, and can be checked.
